crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/Cargo.toml.text:
[package]
name = "aspis-r1-cost-probe"
edition.workspace = true
license.workspace = true
version.workspace = true
description = "UNPROVED R1 COST PROBE, isolated P2 experiments"

[features]
default = []
detail-phases = []
# Existing exact terminal kernels from the selected V7/R117 bundle.
# This changes arithmetic evaluation only; the isolated R1 protocol is unproved.
optimized-terminal = [
    "aspis-statement/pool-v1-pair-forest-packed-digest-selector-tensor-audit",
    "aspis-statement/pool-v1-pair-forest-binary-copy-weights-audit",
    "aspis-statement/pool-v1-pair-forest-endpoint-selector-cache-audit",
    "aspis-statement/pool-v1-pair-forest-semantic-factor-audit",
    "aspis-statement/pool-v1-pair-forest-pattern-window-audit",
    "aspis-statement/pool-v1-pair-forest-copy-tag-dot-basis-audit",
    "aspis-statement/pool-v1-pair-forest-copy-finish-dot-basis-audit",
    "aspis-statement/pool-v1-pair-forest-packed-range-audit",
    "aspis-statement/pool-v1-pair-forest-active-mask-basis-audit",
]
prover = ["dep:aspis-prover", "dep:serde_json", "dep:sha2"]
private-leaf-salts = []
r0-op-count = ["aspis-core/r0-op-count"]

[dependencies]
aspis-core = { path = "../aspis-core", features = ["r0"] }
aspis-statement = { path = "../aspis-statement", features = ["r0", "pool-v1-kernel"] }
aspis-prover = { path = "../aspis-prover", features = ["r0", "insecure-spend-fixture"], optional = true }
serde_json = { workspace = true, optional = true }
sha2 = { workspace = true, optional = true }

[[example]]
name = "semantic_gate"
required-features = ["prover"]

[[example]]
name = "native_gate"
required-features = ["prover"]

[[example]]
name = "masked_fixture_gate"
required-features = ["prover"]

[[example]]
name = "authenticated_tx2_gate"
required-features = ["prover"]

[[example]]
name = "secure_attempt_gate"
required-features = ["prover", "private-leaf-salts"]

[dev-dependencies]
sha2.workspace = true
serde_json.workspace = true
